US President Withdraws ICE Nominee Amidst Credential Backlash

US President Donald Trump's administration has withdrawn the nomination of Ronald Vitiello to lead the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency. The decision followed significant backlash concerning Vitiello's credentials and qualifications for the role. The White House officially announced the withdrawal, marking an end to the controversial nomination process.
